output.summary: KEP-1855 proposes that kubelet fetch audience-bounded service account tokens for pods that CSI drivers mount volumes for, passing them to the driver in NodePublishVolume, and re-execute NodePublishVolume so tokens are refreshed. The KEP is implemented and at stable stage.
output.rationale: Existing CSI drivers read service account tokens directly from the pod filesystem, which breaks under non-root drivers, exposes other pods' secrets via hostPath, defaults the audience to the API server, and fails when automountServiceAccountToken=false. Having kubelet request the token via TokenRequest and re-run NodePublishVolume moves the fetching logic out of each driver and keeps tokens from going stale. The status is implemented, stage stable, so the design was accepted and delivered.

alternatives.option: Grant CSI drivers permission to call the TokenRequest API directly
alternatives.why_not: The readme says this "will require non-trivial admission plugin to do necessary validation and every csi driver needs to reimplement the same functionality."

alternatives.option: Limit the change to a single audience per CSI driver rather than a set of audiences
alternatives.why_not: Discussion raised multi-audience needs (e.g. secrets store with multiple Vault roles); the thread concluded with a single token carrying multiple audiences, and the readme does not record a final choice beyond the design goals. Reviewer mikedanese suggested a single audience, and this was not explicitly settled in the sources.

alternatives.option: Kill or restart pods when token refresh fails
alternatives.why_not: Discussion favored only logging the error: zshihang said "the error will only be logged" because stale secrets might still work, repeated remounts overcome transient errors, and killing a pod may not fix fatal errors.

evidence.quote: this KEP will also give the CSI drivers an option to re-execute `NodePublishVolume` to mount volumes
CSI driver will have access to the secrets of pods that do not use it because the CSI driver should have a `hostPath` volume
This will require non-trivial admission plugin to do necessary validation and every csi driver needs to reimplement the same functionality.
